paragraphs.text: Eluge , the Shoreless Sea , also known as the Flood Gar , is one of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow .

To the animalfolk of Bloomburrow, Eluge is enormous, its giant silvery-scaled body swelling the waters like a sea serpent . It is a 30-40 foot long elemental fish that has countless sharp, jagged teeth and long spikes protruding from its back, belly, and sides, rosy-hued magical markings running along its body, and brightly glowing blue eyes. Eluge is not only the herald of floods, it is the literal manifestation of them. Wherever Eluge swims, the tide swells immediately in its wake, causing rushing waters to rise and waves to crash on the shore. It can create whips of water and cause fear among the animalfolk. It attacked Three Tree City around 4564 AR .
